model.title: Geothermal Energy Advancement Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee, Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Jeff Hurd (R-CO)

summary.text: The bill would establish a geothermal ombudsman within the Interior Department's Bureau of Land Management to streamline the permitting process for geothermal energy projects on federal lands. The ombudsman would resolve disputes between the agency and project applicants, coordinate across different BLM offices, and lead a task force that could bring in staff from other Interior bureaus to speed up project approvals.
